# EM 385-1-1 40-Hour Training

> Online 40-hour safety course developed in line with the updated 2024 U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Safety and Occupational Health Requirements Manual EM 385-1-1, for people working on USACE, Department of Defense and other federal construction projects. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Standard: USACE EM 385-1-1 (2024 edition); course developed per ANSI/ASSP Z490.1-2024
- Duration: about 40 hours (minimum seat time enforced per lesson)
- Content: 23 modules, 122 lessons, mapped to the manual's chapters; final exam
- Credits: 4.0 CEU
- Exam: 70% to pass, 3 attempts
- Price: $349.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Other formats: SCORM package, virtual instructor-led, in-person at client site
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, any device; English and Spanish
- Completion window: 3 months; 1 year of access to materials
- Certificate: Certificate of Completion from HAZWOPER OSHA Training LLC, instant PDF, valid 12 months
- Prerequisites: none
- Note: no EM 385-1-1 course is approved or endorsed by the U.S. government; the requirement is training that meets the manual's standards
- Note: the fall protection module is knowledge-based and does not by itself make someone a Competent or Qualified Person

## Who it is for
Site Safety and Health Officers (SSHOs); contractors and subcontractors on military or federal contracts; construction managers, foremen and supervisors; government and military oversight personnel; QC managers, project engineers and safety consultants.

## How it differs from OSHA Outreach
EM 385-1-1 includes OSHA standards but is more stringent, adding NFPA, EPA, DOT, ANSI and UFGS requirements, plus accident prevention plans, program management and military job site inspections.
